comparisons.standard_comparator: supportive care including visual rehabilitation, low-vision aids, and avoidance of known optic nerve toxins
comparisons.summary: Evidence for idebenone in LHON consists of a single clinical trial with low evidence level, showing variable and context-dependent visual outcomes depending on disease stage and mutation type. The standard comparator (supportive care) is widely accepted but lacks high-quality interventional evidence; however, its use is based on clinical consensus rather than controlled trials.
limitations: No head-to-head comparison with supportive care; idebenone evidence is limited to a single clinical trial with low evidence level and unclear effect magnitude
Outcomes are highly dependent on LHON stage and mutation type, limiting generalizability
Standard comparator lacks interventional evidence but is based on clinical consensus
